name: Compute Gini Impurity and Information Gain for Decision Tree Split
description: Calculates Gini impurity and Delta Gini for a candidate split rule on clinical features, strictly evaluated on the Train partition (N=45).

feature.description: Clinical feature name or recognized alias (e.g. 'radiology_report__pirads', 'radiology_report__psa_density', 'structured_prompt__bx').

threshold.description: Cutoff threshold (float, int, or string category like 'Positive').

unit.description: Optional physical unit for the threshold (e.g. 'ng/ml/cc', 'ng/ml').

target_leaf_id.description: Identifier of the active leaf node being split.
